Who's behind it

One person, two other products on the same board, and a reason.

MF

Michał Florczak

Solo founder, Poland · @b4dgerr · [email protected]

I build Proof of Traction alone: the script, the ranking, the reviews, this page. There is no team behind it.

Why it exists

Launch sites rank projects by upvotes, which mostly measure who brought the most friends on launch day. Proof of Traction ranks them by visitors, measured on each maker's own site by one script, week after week — and shows where those visitors came from. Nothing is self-reported, every week is sealed on Monday, and a number never changes after that.

Also built here

  • Bangerkit — bangerkit.io
  • Talk First — talkfirstplaybook.com

Both are listed on this board and measured exactly like every other project: same script, same checks, same review. They get no special place.
